principles.envelopeIsTheRhythm: Every channel (touch, light, tone) renders the identical envelope. What the hand feels, the eye sees and the ear hears.
principles.severityIsIntensity: Severity never changes a rhythm. Touch grades it in four distinct strengths so DeafBlind users read the level by hand; marks and color count the step for the eye; light and sound deliver at full power from DANGER COMING upward, because they exist to reach.
principles.allClearIsSilence: The all-clear plays nothing on any channel. A quiet device means safe.
principles.mimetic: Every rhythm is the hazard's own temporal signature, converging with the iconicity of sign languages. Future patterns MUST be mimetic.
principles.photosensitivity: Light renderers never exceed 3 flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1) or 6 state transitions per second, and MUST offer a steady-light path for users who identify as photosensitive.
principles.repetition: Urgent alerts repeat the full pattern back to back, with no pause, until the person acknowledges.
principles.fallback: A device that cannot render a pattern falls back to its platform's common cadence, never to silence.
principles.loopSeamlessness: Urgent alerts repeat with no pause, so every family except GROUND ends in a trailing quiet, part of the pattern and counted in its total, sized so the looped stream keeps the family's cadence exactly. A repeat begins at t0 + total; pulses never fuse across the loop boundary. GROUND is the deliberate exception: looped, it fuses into one continuous unbroken hold, which is its mimesis.

GROUND.mimesis: The ground does not pause: one long unbroken hold, like the sustained-shaking signs for earthquake. Looped, it fuses into one continuous shake. Nothing else is unbroken.

WATER.mimesis: Waves keep coming: long soft rolls, a breath apart, like the rolling hand motion of the signs for waves. The cadence is steady under looping.

STORM.mimesis: Wind arrives in gusts that slam: a sharp knock every one and a half seconds, steady under looping.

FIRE.mimesis: Flames flicker fast: ten rapid pulses, like the fingers of the sign for fire flickering upward. Nothing else is this fast. 2.5 flashes per second, inside the 3 per second bound, and the flicker stays exactly 2.5 per second across the loop boundary.

THREAT.meaning: danger from people (attack, active threat, missing child)
THREAT.mimesis: A human threat announces itself: one hard knock at the door, one long push, five rapid fires, then a full stop. The stop is long enough that the next knock lands out of real silence. A sequence nothing natural makes.

TEST.meaning: test or drill, never a real emergency
TEST.mimesis: A quick gentle double tap, a long quiet, then the double tap again: checking, not warning. A drill must never feel like an emergency.

OTHER.meaning: any hazard outside the named families (health, chemical, infrastructure)
OTHER.mimesis: Three steady calls, evenly spaced, then a clean breath: attention without imitation, reserved for what has no shape of its own.

severity.rule: Touch grades severity in four distinct strengths (25, 50, 75, 100 percent), so a DeafBlind user reads the level by touch alone. Light and sound exist to reach: from DANGER COMING (Moderate) upward they deliver at full power, and only BE CAREFUL stays gentle. The filled-mark count (one to three) and the color say the same thing for the eye; color never carries severity alone. The rhythm never changes.
